_comment: Desk risk limits for the Soros book. All limits are UPPER bounds (the measure is bad when high). 'warn' is the amber threshold, 'limit' the red breach. Fractions of book value; weights are fractions. scenario_set is the book-level set the VaR/ES/HHI limits are evaluated against (scenario risk needs one). Edit freely; risk_api reloads on each /limits call.
